map.月球引潮力约为太阳的 2.2 倍；朔（新月）与望（满月）时日月引潮力同向叠加，形: The lunar tidal force is about 2.2 times that of the Sun; at new moon and full moon the solar and lunar tidal forces point the same way and add up, producing the spring tide with the largest range; at the first and last quarters the two are perpendicular, giving the smallest range, the neap tide. map.它把海水视为覆盖全地球的理想流体、仅由天体引力平衡估算潮高，忽略了海陆分布与惯性: It treats sea water as an ideal fluid covering the whole Earth and estimates the tide height from the gravitational balance of the bodies alone, ignoring the distribution of land and sea and inertia; real tides need terrain and resonance corrections added.

From the date, moon phase, mean tidal range and latitude entered, it combines the tidal forces of the Moon and the Sun (equilibrium tide theory) to estimate the combined tide height and predict the tidal range, judges whether the day has a syzygy spring tide or a quadrature neap tide, determines the tide type by latitude (semidiurnal, mixed or diurnal), and finally draws a 24-hour tide height curve with Canvas and estimates the times of high and low tide. All calculations are completed locally in the browser, and data is not uploaded, protecting your privacy.
